question:
Match the following subject matters with their concerned Articles.

 
 

 
 
**a**

 
 
 
**b**

 
 
 

 
 
1.

 
 
 
Superintendence, direction and control of elections to be vested in an Election commission

 </td
solution:
The correct answer is __**4) 1 - B, 2 - C, 3 - A**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article **324** pertains to the **superintendence, direction, and control of elections** to be vested in an Election Commission.
 
• Article **327** deals with the **power of Parliament to make provision** with respect to elections to the legislature.
 
• Article **329** establishes a **bar of interference** by courts in electoral matters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Article**
 **Description**
 
 

 **Article 324**
 Provides the Election Commission the authority to direct, control, and conduct elections to Parliament and to the legislatures of the states, and elections to the offices of President and Vice-President.
 
 

 **Article 327**
 Empowers Parliament to make laws concerning the conduct of elections to both Houses of Parliament and to the House or Houses of the Legislature of each State.
 
 

 **Article 329**
 Bars courts from interfering in electoral matters, especially once the writs for elections have been issued.
